causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Maximum temperatures in New South Wales exceeded 40°C on that day. This drove demand to reach a maximum of 12 334 MW at 4.30 pm.

causes.label: wind_output
causes.quote: Sapphire Wind Farm 187 10 177 Low wind output

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Less than 14 500 MW was offered just before the loss of the interconnector, mostly due to de-rating of plants due to forecast (and then actual) extreme temperatures.

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: A series of unplanned network outages around the VIC-NSW interconnector occurred from around 12.30 pm. These outages culminated in the loss of the VIC-NSW interconnector during the 4 pm trading interval after the Upper and Lower Tumut switching stations were interrupted.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: Rebidding of some generation capacity from low to high prices contributed to the price exceeding $5000/MWh.

causes.label: fcas_co_optimisation
causes.quote: Around half of the high priced intervals were set by the co-optimisation between the Energy and the FCAS markets.

causes.label: constraint_violation
causes.quote: The reasons given all related to a constraint managing the separation of New South Wales from Victoria.

causes.label: interconnector_limit
causes.quote: The outage of the VIC-NSW interconnector resulted in an additional 460 MW of imports from Queensland into New South Wales over the QNI interconnector, up to its maximum nominal capacity of 1000 MW during the high price intervals.

causes.label: administered_pricing_or_intervention
causes.quote: Following the loss of availability from Snowy Hydro's generators, an actual LOR 2 was declared in New South Wales from 4 pm.

interconnectors_named.name: VIC-NSW interconnector

interconnectors_named.name: QNI interconnector
